iSurf signature maker

Fill in the person's details and choose a desktop or mobile layout. The signature below updates automatically.

Putting it into Outlook

  1. Click 1. Download logo GIF. The animated logo is saved to your Downloads folder. (The animated logo does not come through when the signature is pasted, so it is added separately in step 5.)
  2. Click 2. Copy signature.
  3. In Outlook go to File, Options, Mail, Signatures. Choose the signature, click inside the editing box, press Ctrl+A then Delete, then press Ctrl+V. The whole signature appears, with a still picture of the logo on the left.
  4. Click the still logo once and press Delete. The empty spot stays, with the cursor blinking in it.
  5. Use the Insert Picture button in the signature box and choose the downloaded GIF. It arrives much bigger than needed because it is sharp at twice the size. Right-click it, choose Size and Position, tick Lock aspect ratio, and type 230 px for the desktop layout or 140 px for the mobile layout as the width (the height adjusts automatically).
  6. Click OK and send yourself a test email.

Please do not retype the name, title or phone inside Outlook's box. That is what changes the fonts and spacing. Change them here and copy again.
